name: fz-guard
description: Optional fz add-on: hooks that enforce four fz rules at the tool call - Phase 4 approval before writes (including writing Bash) after /fz, confirmation for ad-hoc agents in fz sessions, a registry entry when a turn writes an fz lesson to memory, and a GPT review (or its skip reason) in fz-review turns plus no retired model name in fz plugin files. Opt-in: asks before Bash that runs under configured protected paths. Fails open on any error. Off by env FZ_GUARD_DISABLE or a flag file.
